title: Width test characterization
statement: For every CNF formula $\varphi$ over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$, the Boolean width test returns true if and only if every clause of $\varphi$ has at most three literal occurrences.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables
replaced:
For every CNF formula $\varphi$, the Boolean width scan returns true if and only if
$\varphi$ has width at most $3$, i.e.\ every clause of $\varphi$ has at most three
literals.
